payload.reason: The evidence provides specific machine learning and deep learning methods used for Recognizing Question Entailment (RQE) in the context of question answering.

claims.text: The methods used for RQE include a deep learning model and a logistic regression classifier.
Logistic Regression outperformed other statistical learning algorithms such as SVM and Naive Bayes for classifying question pairs into entailment or no-entailment.
The evaluation of RQE methods was conducted using datasets like SNLI, multiNLI, Quora, Clinical-QE, and SemEval-cQA.
